description: Independent news, reported daily in English and Nepali.
aboutHeroText: News Portal is an independent media outlet based in Biratnagar, Nepal, publishing daily news in both Nepali and English.
aboutMissionText: We believe every Nepali deserves fast, accurate, and unbiased news. From local events to national politics, sports, and international affairs, our team works around the clock to bring you the news that matters.
aboutValue1Text: Every story is verified before publication, so you can trust what you read.
aboutValue2Text: We publish fact-based news, free from political or commercial influence.
aboutValue3Text: Rooted in Biratnagar, our team stays close to local stories and people.
aboutCtaText: Have a story or feedback? We'd love to hear from you.
contactSubheading: Have a tip, feedback, or question? Send us a message.
formSuccessBody: Thanks for reaching out — we'll get back to you soon.
privacyHeroText: Your privacy matters to us. This page explains how we collect and use your information.
termsHeroText: Please read these terms and conditions carefully before using Gurukul TV.

privacySections.heading: Information We Collect
privacySections.body: When you fill out a form on our site (such as the contact form), we may collect your name, email address, and the message you send us. In addition, general technical information about your browser and device may be collected automatically while you use the site.

privacySections.heading: How We Use Information
privacySections.body: The information we collect is used to respond to your questions, improve our services, and contact you when necessary. We do not sell your information to third parties.

privacySections.heading: Cookies
privacySections.body: Our site may use cookies to improve your experience. You can control or disable cookies through your browser settings.

privacySections.heading: Your Rights
privacySections.body: You may request to view, correct, or delete any personal information we hold about you. Please reach out to us through our contact page to make such a request.

privacySections.heading: Changes to This Policy
privacySections.body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any significant changes will be communicated through this page.

termsSections.heading: General Terms
termsSections.body: Welcome to Gurukul TV. Please read these terms of service carefully before using this website. Using this site means you accept these terms. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use this website.

termsSections.heading: Use of Content

No content may be copied, distributed, or republished for commercial purposes without our prior written permission. When sharing content for personal, non-commercial use, the original source must be credited.

termsSections.heading: User Conduct
termsSections.body: By using this website, you agree not to publish or transmit any unlawful, abusive, misleading, or objectionable content. Comments and feedback must use respectful and decent language. Gurukul TV reserves the right to remove any content found in violation of these rules.

termsSections.heading: External Links
termsSections.body: Our website may contain links to other websites. Gurukul TV is not responsible for the content, privacy policy, or practices of these external sites. We recommend reviewing the policies of any external site before visiting it.

termsSections.heading: Accuracy of Content
termsSections.body: Gurukul TV strives to provide accurate and reliable news, but the possibility of errors or inaccuracies in published content cannot be ruled out. Gurukul TV shall not be responsible for any direct or indirect damages arising from errors in any content.

termsSections.heading: Changes to Terms
termsSections.body: Gurukul TV reserves the right to change or update these terms of service as needed. Continued use of the website after such changes constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.

termsSections.heading: Contact Information
termsSections.body: For any questions or inquiries regarding these terms of service, please contact us through our contact page.
